name: Stalker Hamish

intro.text: More deer means more shooting means more money. That's the Enclosure way. Trees? Trees don't pay.
Away you go, before I set the stags on you. They're very loyal. To the feed bucket.

win: Och, fine. Fewer deer it is. They'll have to be happy with the heather.
after: Maybe I'll guide walkers instead. They tip better and they don't need shooting.
